lines.x: Germany missed its natural gas storage target for the start of winter as the European gas benchmark exceeded 100 euros per MWh.
Eurozone annual inflation accelerated to 4% in October, driven higher by a jump in energy costs.
European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde warned that inflation will remain elevated in the coming quarters, noting risks grow as interest rates stay high longer.
European shares dropped as an Apple margin warning sparked a broader global technology stock sell-off.
